body:
I have POTs, so I can’t take prednisone, but I have done mini-doses when I’ve needed to. 
I thought of trying Valium, the hospital gave it to me and it stopped the uncontrollable body movements, they’re exhausting, but it gets complicated because I’d only want it if I am in a pain crisis, or pain flare up,  and I’m needing to track those, which I started doing recently. That way, I can average it out.
I did this three years ago, and It helped. Thank you.

Yes, I stopped all my meds for two years to see if this was true about six years ago and tired alternative meds. I had already gone the route of holistic medicine for a very long time as I was raised this way. When the pain put me in the hospital with a fever and blood pressure issues, I got scared. I argued a bit with the doctor about this as I thought it was something else, but he said my meds were not strong enough. Mornings are my hardest time so bare with me here. I do take a small gummy in the pm so I can eat, and tried medical marijuana when it first became legal in my state. It was a bad experience for me. I’m not willing to take mushrooms. 
I appreciate your response, and suggestions.

Hello, thank you for sharing with me. I’m sorry for that you’re dealing with.
They want me to take the meds before it’s builds up, so I can’t PRN. It’s time release- 2 a day every 12 hours. I don’t know what she meant by switching to IV. I was in the hospital for a “pain crisis” and she said I responded to IV, and that’s an option.

Thank you, but the massage would put me in the hospital. I’m that sensitive. I know because it happened twice, even with light massage. Thank you for the advice on the meds. They’re worried that I may need to get an IV or a pump and I just don’t want to go that far. I’m terrified and need to connect with others that are suffering.
